quest.title: "Judgment Day"
quest.description: On the streets of the Court of Fontaine, a pair of familiar faces seem to need your help...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x325, Mora x22000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x5

talks.objective: Go to the Court of Fontaine: Quartier Lyonnais

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: ...Still no dice?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Not at all, and I've asked pretty much everyone in the Court of Fontaine already.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Lynette's ears drooped as soon as she heard that we'd have to be out and about for days on end. And Freminet... he hid himself under his helmet as soon as he realized there'd be people around that he didn't know.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: What about Chiori and Charlotte? I feel like both of them would be more than up to it.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: I've asked them already, but they're both pretty busy right now. I just gave the members of the Spina a few days off, too, so I don't want to bother them, either...

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Hmm... This is getting pretty difficult.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Navia! Clorinde! What's up?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Oh my! Well if it isn't my dear partners! How are you all doing?

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Ha... Navia!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Huh? ...Ooh! You mean...

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Yep, this is our chance...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Do you need our help with something...?

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Precisely! My dear partners, we've got a huge problem right now that only you can solve!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Woah! For real?

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Absolutely. We've already exhausted all our other options.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon...

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Would you join us, and play "Marechaussee Hunter: Judgment Day"!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Marechaussee what now?

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: It's a new game script by the Tabletop Troupe, a local roleplay adventure club.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Ever heard of the Tabletop Troupe? They put out games that allow you to participate in a story and roleplay characters with your friends. I've loved their stuff ever since I was a kid.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That sounds super interesting!

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Clorinde and I are both veteran members of the club. Recently, someone came up with a new script and was looking for people to help playtest it for them.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: And when they asked, of course I couldn't refuse. I mean, come on, a brand new script! Nobody has ever played it before!

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Mm-hmm. Generally speaking, scripts at that level of development have a lot of issues, but I think this one is pretty solid. The author obviously put a lot of work into the story, and the worldbuilding is also quite credible.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Woah, woah, woah! I know I was the one that handed you the script, but some of us haven't read it yet! No spoilers, please!

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: ...Anyway, the script calls for a team of four. Ah, yes. We're missing one final player right now.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You were right, that is a big problem!

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: So... you're saying you'll help us out? I knew I could count on you, partner!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon and {NICKNAME} are kind of a package deal. Is that okay?

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: That's not a problem. I'll adjust the pace based on the actual number of players and ensure that everyone has a good time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well, {NICKNAME}, what do you think? Wanna play? Paimon will follow your lead.

choices.text: I always help a friend in need.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Well, that solves our problem. You have our thanks.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Woo-hoo! I'll go grab the script manager from the club right away.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The script manager? Didn't you just say that you gave Clorinde the script?

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: The club introduced a completely new kind of gameplay for this script.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: In this iteration, the Game Master's version of the script is incomplete. The script manager provides the next part of the script only after players have completed the current list of objectives.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: On top of that, in order to increase player immersion, the club has created some of the story's sets and scenes in real life. We'll only know where we should go once the script manager reveals the starting location.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, you're right, whoever wrote this script really did put in a lot of work!

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Hehe, and it's got a real healthy amount of suspense, right? I mean, even the GM doesn't know how the story will end!

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: I look forward to experiencing it with you all.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Why don't you go meet up with the others first? They should all be waiting at Chioriya Boutique. I'll come over with the script manager as soon as I find them.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Sounds good. Remember to always watch where you're going, and don't rush.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: You say that like I'm six years old or something!

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Hmm... Let me think, what kind of character should I play this time?

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: ...I just hope you'll pick up some useful skills this time. Oh, and stop trying to "persuade" every animal you come across...

choices.text: Count me in for a great script!

talks.objective: Meet up with the others at Chioriya Boutique

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Sorry to keep you waiting.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: #Ah, you're back! Huh? And you've got {NICKNAME} and Paimon with you, too.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: What a pleasant surprise. I assume you'll be joining us for the game, then?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Lyney! Furina! Paimon didn't know you were playing, too! Are you also members of the Tabletop Troupe?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hey, you two.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Hmm, I'm more of a casual member, if anything. I haven't taken part in many formal club activities. Lynette, Freminet, and I play something similar at the Hotel Bouffes d'ete sometimes, but I'm usually the GM.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Still, I'm sure it'll be fun being a player for the first time. I'm looking forward to it.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Well, I'm not a member of the club at all. Clorinde simply woke me up first thing this morning, said there was a good script worth experiencing, and asked if I wanted in.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: If you're interested, I can give you a referral. That should give you a 40% discount on membership fees.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: I think I'll wait to see how this experience plays out first, especially when it comes to the quality of the script. If it's sufficiently fun, then I'll join.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you participate in a lot of Tabletop Troupe activities, Clorinde?

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: You could say that. She's actually one of the few "Senior Game Masters" of the Troupe.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Ah, right. I knew about that even when she was still my subordinate.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: ...It's nothing, really. Just a small hobby of mine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, Paimon's so used to seeing you be all upstanding and intimidating as the Champion Duelist. It's kinda hard to imagine you roleplaying with a bunch of friends...

choices.text: So, if we have a problem with any of the rules...

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Surely you jest. I would never intentionally make things difficult for my players.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: I maintain a clear boundary between my professional and personal lives. The me you see at court represents the law and order of Fontaine. I put all personal feelings to the side and grant a fair duel to all who seek to defend their honor.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: But in my personal life, I'm just an ordinary person — someone who feels anger and sadness, just like everyone else.

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: Well, you say that, but for all the time I've known you, I don't think I've ever seen you cry... I've seen you get angry, sure, but... now I'm wondering whether you were actually mad or if it just looked that way from the outside?

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: I was probably in work mode during those times.

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: Is that so? Well, in any case, I just feel like even in your personal life, you don't get emotional very often.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: So, you want to see me cry? That might be a little difficult. A show of anger, though... That might be something I could accomplish.

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: N—No, that's not what I meant...

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: I'm back! Here, allow me to introduce you to the script manager, Mr. Florian!

response.speaker: Florian
response.text: Pleasure to meet you all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hello! Wait, are you a Champion Duelist too, Mr. Florian?

response.speaker: Florian
response.text: Oh, no. This is just the costume provided by the club. I occasionally play a few roles in my scripts.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: That sounds like a lot of work.

response.speaker: Florian
response.text: It's nothing. It's the least we can do to give the players a more immersive experience.

response.speaker: Florian
response.text: Anyway, allow me to give you a brief introduction of the script—

response.speaker: Florian
response.text: This script was adapted from the real history of the Marechaussee Hunters. You all will play the role of Hunters from a bygone era, and resolve a series of events unfolding in the capital.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Erm... Paimon's not super familiar with the history of the Marechaussee Hunters. Is that a problem...?

response.speaker: Florian
response.text: Oh, no problem at all. I can give you a brief run down. So, basically, Marechaussee Hunters were people who dedicated themselves to hunting monsters and protecting the city by using a special swordsmanship technique passed down over generations.

response.speaker: Florian
response.text: Their story can be traced back to the ancient Remurian dynasty, as well as the first hunter, Cassiodor...

response.speaker: Florian
response.text: But, I'll leave the finer details for you to seek out and discover later.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Mhm, and I'll provide additional commentary as the story progresses.

response.speaker: Florian
response.text: In that case... Ahem! Brave hunters, are you ready to set out on an unknown adventure?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa! Just one sentence, and it's like we're in the story already!

response.speaker: Florian
response.text: Aha, I see many a determined gaze before me. Very well. Head over to this location, and begin your heroic journey!

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: So as we follow the story, it leads us to specific scenes? Sounds pretty innovative. What does the message in the envelope say?

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: It's the exact location of the scene, as well as the formal permission to use the venue. Seems like they have everything prepared.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Please check all your belongings, everyone, and make sure you haven't forgotten anything. Once you're ready, please follow me to the designated location.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds good! Hunter squad, move out!

choices.text: Do we have to submit a duel request to you...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Do you also see Navia and Clorinde over there?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They look like they might have run into some kind of trouble... Let's go check out what's going on!
